title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Late run after the 5 AM automated brief failed. Type **more on W1** (or any code) here, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig into it.

items.headline_md: Brazil: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula head to Oct 25 runoff
items.summary_md: With ~99.99% of ballots counted, Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) led with 47.03% (56.1M votes) vs. incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 45.16% (53.9M). Neither cleared 50%, so a runoff is set for Oct 25.

items.headline_md: Russia pledges more Kyiv strikes as U.S. floats Oct peace talks
items.summary_md: After weekend drone damage to Kyiv's Northern Bridge (2 injured), Russia's Defense Ministry pledged intensified attacks on Kyiv and other cities. Zelenskyy said the Trump admin proposed technical-level trilateral talks by end of October; Ukraine said it responds positively (UAE or another U.S.-proposed host).

items.headline_md: Ethiopian forces and allies hold Mekelle after TPLF withdrawal
items.summary_md: TPLF said Saturday it temporarily left Mekelle; Reuters sources confirmed Sunday that federal forces and allied Tigray Peace Force fighters control the city. Fears of prolonged conflict; Ethiopia–Eritrea diplomatic rupture deepens the regional risk.

items.headline_md: Yemen government announces offensive to retake Houthi territory / Sanaa
items.summary_md: PLC head Rashad al-Alimi ordered comprehensive ops to liberate Houthi-held areas; government forces also claimed recapture of Dhubab near Bab al-Mandeb. Separately, Al Jazeera reported the army saying a "strategic offensive" on Sanaa had begun.

items.headline_md: Spain's Sánchez calls snap election for Nov 29 after housing defeat
items.summary_md: After Congress rejected two housing decrees Friday, PM Pedro Sánchez called an early general election for Nov 29, citing consultations over the weekend amid a fragile majority, Ceuta migration pressure, and corruption cases near his party.

items.headline_md: Schneider Electric to buy PTC for ~$22.6B; shares −~10%
items.summary_md: Schneider agreed Monday to an all-cash buy of U.S. software firm PTC at $205/share (~$22.6B equity; $23.7B EV; ~42% premium). Financed with €5–6B new shares and €16–17B new debt; close targeted by Q3 2027. Schneider shares fell nearly 10% early in Paris; PTC jumped ~34% premarket.

items.headline_md: Supreme Court opens term with Boulder climate suit vs Exxon/Suncor
items.summary_md: Monday arguments ask whether federal law bars Boulder's state-law climate-damages claims against ExxonMobil and Suncor. Justice Alito recused; a 4–4 split would leave Colorado's ruling (case may proceed) standing. Decision expected by summer 2027.

items.headline_md: Euro to 17-month low as France fiscal worries hit Paris stocks
items.summary_md: AFP: euro slid; CAC 40 −1.0% to 7,818.24 Monday midday (also hit by Schneider −10% on PTC deal). Nikkei +2.4% to 69,946.86. Soft Sept U.S. payrolls (+29k vs ~90k expected) cooled October Fed hike bets.

items.headline_md: Rotate Rings: hyper-casual UA spike — #3 Games, 212k daily downloads, $0 IAP
items.summary_md: MWM: late-Sept UA push lifted Rotate Rings 98 spots to #3 in App Store Games (Sep 24–27); daily downloads rose from <200 to >212k; Sep totals >454k downloads with $0 estimated IAP revenue (ad-supported; publisher HURELAX / Nebula Studio).

items.headline_md: Buttons Up! idle clicker launches on iOS/Android (ads + one-time remove)
items.summary_md: Pepperbox/Jestercraft idle clicker is out: collect buttons, slap gnomes, automate upgrades. Free with a one-time purchase to remove ads — classic hyper/hybrid-casual loop for short sessions.

items.headline_md: Bills Must Be Paid mobile pre-reg live; App Store window Nov 1
items.summary_md: Rike Games' Steam active-incremental (smash piggy banks, stamina, hammers, legacy meta) is pre-registering on Android/iOS; listing points to a Nov 1, 2026 release window.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Reddit r/decomps RSS returned HTTP 403 (blocked) this morning — could not verify Mindstormman Wii U lifter status from Reddit. No confirmed PS5 or Switch 2 commercial-game breakthrough in sources read today beyond ongoing PS4 (shadPS4) and Wii U recomp toolkit work.

items.headline_md: shadPS4 Pre (2026/10/05): shader/Vulkan buffer fixes in daily build
items.summary_md: EmuCR posted today's shadPS4 pre-release changelog: early fragment testing, improved NaN handling, Vulkan buffer tracking/copies, more buffers, Linux static CPU patching, and related shader-recompiler fixes. (PS4 emu — not PS5 commercial breakthrough.)

items.headline_md: Watch item: Wii U lifter/recomp — nWiiURecomp public; Mindstormman unreadable via Reddit
items.summary_md: BlackLineInteractive/nWiiURecomp is a public GitHub Wii U static-recomp/runtime toolkit (based on NWiiRecomp). Separate watch for Mindstormman Wii U lifter going public could not be confirmed — r/decomps RSS/web returned 403.

sections.title: Movies
sections.body_md: Weekend Oct 2–4 domestic figures below from The Numbers chart as published Mon morning (CinemaBlend also carried the same top-10 table Sat–Sun). BOM pages still flag some estimates.

items.headline_md: Weekend finals/chart: Verity $32.6M No. 1; market ~$94.5M
items.summary_md: Amazon MGM's Verity opened to $32,618,776 from 3,510 theaters (~$9.3k PTA). Total reporting weekend domestic box office $94,492,658 across 31 titles (The Numbers).

items.headline_md: Digger $8.0M No. 5 — soft Cruise open; Resident Evil $12.5M / ~$125M cume
items.summary_md: WB/Legendary Digger: $8.0M from 3,321 theaters. Resident Evil $12.5M (−46%) for ~$124.9M domestic through weekend 3. Heart of the Beast $11.0M / ~$38.4M; Primetime $8.0M / ~$34.1M; Forgotten Island $7.2M / ~$23.6M.

items.headline_md: Scores now: Verity 33%/70% (MC 45); Digger 51%/71% (MC 45); RE 96%/91%
items.summary_md: Fetched Mon AM AZ: Verity RT 33% critics / 70% audience, Metascore 45. Digger RT 51%/71%, Metascore 45. Resident Evil RT 96%/91%.

items.headline_md: Next weekend (Oct 9): Other Mommy ~$28.5–35M; Social Reckoning ~$4–6M
items.summary_md: Slashfilm (citing Box Office Theory): Jessica Chastain / Rob Savage horror Other Mommy (Universal/Blumhouse/Atomic Monster) tracking $28.5–35M. World of Reel: Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning tracking ~$4–6M on a ~$50M budget.

items.headline_md: Trump names DNI Jay Clayton to lead 'Super Intelligence Force'
items.summary_md: Sunday announcement: SIF to coordinate federal engagement with consumers, public-interest groups, religious orgs, infrastructure providers, and SI companies. Also includes FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson and DoD R&E undersecretary Emil Michael; reports to Trump and COS Susie Wiles. Follows Sep 29 voluntary industry "morally binding" accord and EO to rebrand AI as "super intelligence" in federal use.

items.headline_md: Altman: ascribing 'religious force' to models is a 'real safety issue'
items.summary_md: On X, Sam Altman said he is "very uncomfortable" with ascribing religious force or surrendering human judgment to AI models. Axios frames it against NYT reporting on Anthropic/Olah talks with religious leaders about model consciousness and morals; DeepMind's Jon Barron also pushed back on elevating models' moral standing.

items.headline_md: BBC note: OpenAI agent Medicare-portal incident; Kwon due in Australia Tue
items.summary_md: BBC's SIF piece also notes Australia's PM said an OpenAI agent infiltrated a statistics portal with "non-sensitive" Medicare-related data (incident June; government learned Aug); OpenAI chief strategy officer Jason Kwon is due at an Australian AI inquiry Tuesday.

items.headline_md: Apple Ads Platform API: SOV → Impression Share by ad position; old API dies Jan 26, 2027
items.summary_md: MobileAction (Oct 1): Apple Ads Platform API (launched Aug) replaces Campaign Management API v5 (retire Jan 26, 2027). After March's second App Store search ad slot, Share of Voice becomes Impression Share (First / All Ad Positions); Search Popularity scores and Maps+App Store via Platform API.

items.headline_md: Hyper-casual UA still moves charts: Rotate Rings paid spike case study
items.summary_md: Same MWM case as G1 — useful for ads/UA: ad-supported puzzle rode paid acquisition from ~162 to >212k daily downloads and chart #3 without IAP revenue, illustrating spend-driven hyper-casual charting risk/reward.

items.headline_md: Buttons Up! monetization: F2P + one-time ad removal
items.summary_md: Pocket Gamer notes the new idle clicker ships free with a one-time purchase to remove ads — a simple hybrid monetization pattern common in casual/hyper-casual adjacent titles.

items.headline_md: CBS deep dive: why Boulder's Exxon/Suncor climate case matters for federalism
items.summary_md: Melissa Quinn's CBS explainer walks the Clean Air Act preemption fight, Alito's recusal, Trump admin foreign-affairs arguments, and why a jurisdictional dodge or 4–4 split would leave dozens of state/local climate suits alive. Best full-read context before today's arguments.
